director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has 435 canonical experiments and 1401 historical evidence artifacts but still no validated external-agent product. Its prior portfolio directive already re-pointed all six lanes at the three structural blockers named by the cumulative audit: B1 (a shipped executable parameterized carrier; kernel.py emits literals at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold and has no distill_parameterized), B2 (a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank with non-ceiling cold/retrieval dynamic range), and B3 (a same-model credential-free endpoint that can actually drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent task). None of the three readiness conditions holds in current accepted evidence, so the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON full benchmark must NOT be funded this cycle; the correct use of the cycle is to keep Product, Runtime and Intel on their blocker-removal experiments, complete the already-frozen Physics transaction, and continue the two fresh designs (Graph delta-repair re-measurement, Frontier acquisition-cost scaling law) that replace threads which repeatedly failed with the same prerequisite. Every lane's active experiment already targets the right claim under a recorded portfolio mandate, so this cycle is a deliberate continuation, not allocation inertia, after an explicit cognitive reset for each lane. Only Physics carries a FROZEN transaction and is therefore not re-directable; the other five carry unfinished PREFREEZE work whose mandate is still strategically correct.
